_doc: Handler-level ratchet baseline for scripts/check-convention-guard.cjs. Keys are exact '<route module> <HTTP method> <path>' endpoint ids. rule3_pending may only SHRINK: add an awaited handler-owned audit after the write, then remove the key. rule3_exempt is only for physically verified non-persistent calls or derived/infra writes; exemptions must also remain live and exact.
_migration: 2026-08-08: replaced the file-level baseline (which could be masked by one sibling audit) with an AST-derived endpoint baseline. This one-time expansion exposes previously invisible handler debt; future changes may only shrink or explicitly classify a newly introduced endpoint.

rule3_exempt.apprenticeship GET /:projectId/mentors/a: false positive: byMentor.set mutates an in-memory Map used to aggregate availability; no persistent write
rule3_exempt.b2dAdmin POST /keys: the key creation is already followed by an awaited audit_logs write; the later b2d_events.add is an operational event-stream append, not a second unaudited business mutation
rule3_exempt.b2dAdmin POST /keys/:id/revoke: the key revocation is already followed by an awaited audit_logs write; the later b2d_events.add is an operational event-stream append, not a second unaudited business mutation
rule3_exempt.billing/appstore POST /webhook/apple: correlated idempotency branch: the mutation callback only executes for fresh/stale work, and those outcomes receive an awaited handler-owned billing webhook audit; duplicate paths do not execute the mutation
rule3_exempt.billing/googleplay POST /webhook: correlated idempotency branch: the subscription mutation callback only executes for fresh/stale work, and those outcomes receive an awaited handler-owned billing webhook audit
rule3_exempt.billing/khipu POST /khipu/webhook: correlated payment/idempotency branches: invoice status writes have direct awaited audit_logs rows and successful fresh/stale outcomes receive an awaited handler-owned webhook audit

rule3_exempt.incidentFlow GET /:projectId/incident-fl: false positive: assignedMap/completedKeys are in-memory Map/Set aggregations for a status response
rule3_exempt.incidentTrends GET /:projectId/incidents: false positive: byId.set deduplicates an in-memory incident list
false positive: byId/bucketMap mutations build in-memory trend buckets

rule3_exempt.riskRadar GET /:projectId/repeating-risk: false positive: seen.set writes an in-memory deduplication Map

rule3_exempt.telemetry POST /telemetry/ingest: infra telemetry: telemetry_events is the canonical validated telemetry sink; auditing the telemetry ingestion into another telemetry stream would recurse
rule3_exempt.wisdomCapsule GET /wisdom-capsule/stats: false positive: statsCache.set writes a process-local response cache
rule3_exempt.wisdomCapsule GET /wisdom-capsule/today: derived projection: cacheRef.set persists a deterministic capsule cache derived from existing findings

rule3_exempt.zettelkastenGraphMutations POST /graph/m: correlated transaction result: txn.update populates migrated, and non-empty migrated receives awaited auditGraphMutation (a verified local auditServerEvent wrapper)
rule3_exempt.zettelkastenGraphMutations POST /graph/n: correlated transaction result: txn.create returns created=true, and created=true receives awaited auditGraphMutation (a verified local auditServerEvent wrapper)
